title: Backup-QB cascade backtest (R92) - data/backup_qb_backtest.json
description: MEASURE-ONLY record of the backup-quarterback cascade on the shipped weekly number (weekly_split_v2), written by scripts/backtest_backup_qb.py on the committed corpus data/fixtures/backtest_weekly/. Walk-forward throughout: the quarterback room comes from depth-chart snapshots strictly before the week, the condition from the FINAL injury report for the week, passer capability from dropbacks before the week, and every candidate parameter is fitted only on seasons before the one it is scored on. STRICT: additionalProperties is false at every level, so a producer that grows a key must grow this contract with it and a typo reds the gate instead of passing unnoticed. Nothing in this document is applied to a projection - verdict.adopted is false in phase 1 and no shipped builder reads the file. Optional feed: absent on a clone that has never run the backtest, validated strictly whenever present.
